title: upgrade-impact comparison after v18: report the non-access classes to the administrator, and retire the zero-consumer package-upgrade.zod.ts
body:
Filing gate **③**: a task the maintainer directed. Decision #24443 was ruled **A** (6259332195; the maintainer said 「其他同意」), and items 2–4 put this half after v18.
- **Reader who acts:** the epic seat, or whichever lane holds this card after v18.
- **Dedupe:** none was found; this card carries #24443's after-v18 half.

Blocked-by: #24446

## What the ruling binds (items 2–4 of 6259332195)
- **The other classes are reported.** That means the O overlays (views, dashboards, reports, translations, email templates), the C behavioural types (flows and actions; validations and scheduled jobs, which have no switch today), the E extensions (objects and apps) and settings. They use the same comparison #24446 builds. Each finding goes to the administrator, not only to the server log; none is refused.
- **Retire `packages/spec/src/kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts`** (plan, diff, conflict, snapshot, rollback; zero runtime consumers), with its ADR-0087 conversion.
- No rename spelling is added to the spec (item 5).

## Measured silent cases (`origin/main` `e22defb13c`; seat measurement behind #24443)
| class | silent case | evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Flow, action | A rename re-enables a disabled item, with a double fire beside a clone. A removal orphans the ledger row. One action row disables every same-named action on every object. | `service-automation/src/engine.ts:5244`; `objectql/src/action-activation.ts:49` |
| O overlays | A removal leaves an orphan that keeps serving. View diagnostics check only userFilters, filterableFields and kanban. | `metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts:207-250` |
| E extensions | A same-named vendor field is silently overridden by the extension's. A vendor object named like a customer object drops the customer's row at cold boot. | `objectql/src/registry.ts:262`; `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:31206` |
| Settings | A renamed key orphans the stored value, and the default applies. | `platform-objects/src/system/sys-setting.object.ts:242` |
